name: cnetworkstandard
description: The chapter network's configuration-version stamp. Spec: cnetworkstandard-entity-crm-handoff.md (sections 1 and 2). Six plain scalars, no links, no enums, stream off — deliberately the least interesting entity in the CRM.

fields.name: standardVersion
fields.label: Standard version
fields.tooltipText: The configuration standard's version, and the field everything reads.

fields.name: appliedAt
fields.label: Applied at
fields.tooltipText: When the apply COMPLETED. A partial apply must not stamp at all.

fields.name: appliedBy
fields.label: Applied by
fields.tooltipText: Which account applied it, so an unexpected change is traceable to a credential.

fields.name: planFingerprint
fields.label: Plan fingerprint
fields.tooltipText: Fingerprint of the dry-run plan that was applied — what makes 'which plan actually ran' answerable afterwards.

fields.name: appliedByTool
fields.label: Applied by tool
fields.tooltipText: Which applier wrote it, and its version.
